question:
Spot the error.

The little boy can to swim across the river (A) / without any help from (B) / his elder brother or sister. (C)

options.text: The little boy can to swim across the river

explanation: Modal (can) के बाद bare infinitive (V1) आता है, 'to' नहीं: 'can swim'।

question:
Spot the error.

The company has decided opening a new branch (A) / in the city next month and (B) / has already hired two managers. (C)

options.text: The company has decided opening a new branch
in the city next month and

explanation: 'Decide' के बाद to-infinitive आता है: 'decided to open'।

question:
Spot the error.

You had better to consult a doctor (A) / immediately because the pain (B) / has been increasing since morning. (C)

options.text: You had better to consult a doctor

explanation: 'Had better' के बाद bare infinitive आता है: 'had better consult'।

question:
Spot the error.

The strict principal never let (A) / the students to leave the hall (B) / before the national anthem was over. (C)

options.text: the students to leave the hall
before the national anthem was over.

explanation: 'Let' के बाद bare infinitive आता है: 'let the students leave'।

question:
Spot the error.

The old man is too weak (A) / that he cannot walk (B) / without the help of a stick. (C)

options.text: The old man is too weak
without the help of a stick.

explanation: 'Too + adjective + to + V1' structure आता है: 'too weak to walk'।

question:
Spot the error.

Looking at her struggle, (A) / I cannot but to admire her courage (B) / in such a difficult situation. (C)

options.text: I cannot but to admire her courage

explanation: 'Cannot but' के बाद bare infinitive आता है: 'cannot but admire'।

question:
Spot the error.

Everyone in the audience was spellbound (A) / when they heard (B) / the little girl to sing a patriotic song. (C)

options.text: Everyone in the audience was spellbound
the little girl to sing a patriotic song.

explanation: Perception verbs (hear, see, watch) के बाद active में bare infinitive आता है: 'heard the little girl sing'।

question:
Spot the error.

Everyone knows that Rohan is a sincere boy, (A) / and he is also (B) / intelligent enough that he can solve such problems. (C)

options.text: Everyone knows that Rohan is a sincere boy,
intelligent enough that he can solve such problems.

explanation: 'Adjective + enough + to + V1' structure आता है: 'intelligent enough to solve'।

question:
Spot the error.

Instead of preparing for the examination, (A) / the lazy student does (B) / nothing but to waste his time in the playground. (C)

options.text: Instead of preparing for the examination,
nothing but to waste his time in the playground.

explanation: 'Nothing but / do nothing but' के बाद bare infinitive आता है: 'nothing but waste'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The doctor advised me [taking] complete rest for two weeks.
explanation: 'Advise + object + to-infinitive' आता है: 'advised me to take'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

I want [that you should help me] with the project this weekend.
explanation: 'Want' के बाद that-clause नहीं आती; 'want + object + to + V1' आता है: 'want you to help me'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

It is very kind [for you] to help the poor villagers.
explanation: व्यक्ति का गुण बताने वाले adjective (kind, rude, foolish, clever) के बाद 'of + person' आता है: 'kind of you'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

He went to the market [for buying] some fruits for his sick mother.
explanation: उद्देश्य (purpose) बताने के लिए to-infinitive आता है: 'went to the market to buy'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

I clearly remember [to meet] him at the railway station five years ago.
explanation: बीती हुई बात याद करने के लिए 'remember + gerund' आता है: 'remember meeting him'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The farmer was [so tired to walk] any further.
explanation: 'Too + adjective + to + V1' structure आता है: 'too tired to walk'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

It is better [to be silent than speaking] nonsense in public.

options.text: to be silent than to speak

explanation: तुलना में दोनों हिस्से समान रूप (parallel) में होने चाहिए: 'to be silent than to speak'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The teacher made the students [stay] back after school to finish the project.
explanation: 'Make + object' के बाद active में bare infinitive आता है: 'made the students stay'। इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

He was too excited [to sleep] on the night before the final match.
explanation: 'Too + adjective + to + V1' सही है, इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

She seems to have forgotten (A) / the promise that she made (B) / to her friend last week. (C)
explanation: 'Seems to have forgotten' (perfect infinitive) और 'the promise that she made' दोनों सही हैं। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

The Prime Minister is to visit Japan next week (A) / and is expected to sign (B) / several important agreements there. (C)

options.text: The Prime Minister is to visit Japan next week

explanation: 'Is to + V1' (तय कार्यक्रम) और 'is expected to sign' दोनों सही हैं। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

We regret to inform you (A) / that your application has been rejected (B) / due to incomplete documents. (C)

options.text: that your application has been rejected

explanation: 'Regret to inform' (खेद के साथ सूचित करना) का प्रयोग सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

It is no use to cry over spilt milk (A) / because whatever has happened (B) / cannot be undone now. (C)

options.text: It is no use to cry over spilt milk

explanation: 'It is no use' के बाद gerund (V+ing) आता है: 'It is no use crying'।

question:
Spot the error.

The heavy snowfall prevented us to cross (A) / the mountain pass, so (B) / we returned to the base camp. (C)

options.text: The heavy snowfall prevented us to cross
we returned to the base camp.

explanation: 'Prevent ... from' के बाद gerund आता है: 'prevented us from crossing'।

question:
Spot the error.

Would you mind to open the window (A) / because it is very hot (B) / in this crowded room? (C)

options.text: Would you mind to open the window

explanation: 'Mind' के बाद gerund आता है: 'Would you mind opening the window?'।

question:
Spot the error.

The naughty boy was afraid of (A) / his teacher and avoided to meet him (B) / after the incident. (C)

options.text: The naughty boy was afraid of
his teacher and avoided to meet him

explanation: 'Avoid' के बाद gerund आता है: 'avoided meeting'।

question:
Spot the error.

The poor widow (A) / spent the whole night to prepare (B) / sweets for the festival. (C)

options.text: spent the whole night to prepare

explanation: 'Spend + time + V-ing' structure आता है: 'spent the whole night preparing'।

question:
Spot the error.

After many failed attempts, (A) / the young engineer succeeded to repair (B) / the damaged machine. (C)

options.text: the young engineer succeeded to repair

explanation: 'Succeed in' के बाद gerund आता है: 'succeeded in repairing'।

question:
Spot the error.

Our children are very excited about the trip (A) / to Goa and are (B) / looking forward to see the beaches there. (C)

options.text: Our children are very excited about the trip
looking forward to see the beaches there.

explanation: 'Look forward to' में 'to' preposition है, इसलिए उसके बाद gerund आता है: 'looking forward to seeing'।

question:
Spot the error.

Since the project was already behind schedule, (A) / the manager seriously considered (B) / to hire more workers for the site. (C)

options.text: Since the project was already behind schedule,
to hire more workers for the site.

explanation: 'Consider' के बाद gerund आता है: 'considered hiring'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The residents strongly objected [to be asked] to vacate the old building.
explanation: 'Object to' में 'to' preposition है, इसलिए passive gerund आता है: 'objected to being asked'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

He is devoted [to help] the poor and the needy.
explanation: 'Devoted to' में 'to' preposition है, इसलिए gerund आता है: 'devoted to helping'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

[After to complete] the project, he took a long vacation.
explanation: Preposition (after, before, on, without) के बाद gerund आता है: 'After completing'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The doctor told him to stop [to smoke] immediately.
explanation: किसी काम को रोकने के अर्थ में 'stop + gerund' आता है: 'stop smoking'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

She is not interested [to learn] music at this age.
explanation: 'Interested in' के बाद gerund आता है: 'interested in learning'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

With a view [to get] promoted, he worked day and night.
explanation: 'With a view to' में 'to' preposition है, इसलिए gerund आता है: 'with a view to getting'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

I could not resist [to buy] the beautiful dress displayed in the shop window.
explanation: 'Resist' के बाद gerund आता है: 'could not resist buying'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

I am looking forward to [meeting] the new director next week.
explanation: 'Look forward to' में 'to' preposition है, इसलिए gerund (meeting) सही है। कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

The lecture was so bored (A) / that most of the students (B) / started yawning in the middle. (C)
explanation: जो बोर करे वह 'boring' और जो खुद बोर हो वह 'bored'। Lecture के लिए 'boring' आता है।

question:
Spot the error.

Finished his homework, (A) / he went out (B) / to play in the park. (C)
explanation: Participle का doer 'he' है और काम पहले पूरा हुआ, इसलिए perfect participle आता है: 'Having finished his homework'।

question:
Spot the error.

Having finished the day's work, (A) / the lights were switched off (B) / by the peon. (C)
explanation: Dangling participle: 'Having finished' का doer 'the peon' होना चाहिए, 'lights' नहीं। सही: 'the peon switched off the lights'।

question:
Spot the error.

Standing on the balcony of the old fort, (A) / the whole city looked beautiful (B) / to the tourists. (C)

options.text: Standing on the balcony of the old fort,

explanation: Dangling participle: 'Standing on the balcony' का doer 'the tourists' होना चाहिए। सही: 'the tourists found the whole city beautiful'।

question:
Spot the error.

The students were very sad (A) / because the result of the examination (B) / was extremely disappointed. (C)

options.text: because the result of the examination

explanation: Result निराश करने वाला है, इसलिए 'disappointing'; व्यक्ति के लिए 'disappointed' आता है।

question:
Spot the error.

The tourists were extremely tired (A) / after the long journey and (B) / were very exciting to reach the hotel. (C)

options.text: were very exciting to reach the hotel.

explanation: Tourists खुद उत्साहित महसूस कर रहे हैं, इसलिए 'excited' आता है; 'exciting' वह है जो excite करे।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

She was [disappointing] with the result of the examination.
explanation: व्यक्ति की feeling के लिए past participle (-ed) आता है: 'disappointed'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

Walking in the park, [a snake was seen by me].
explanation: Dangling participle: 'Walking in the park' का doer 'I' होना चाहिए, इसलिए 'I saw a snake'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

The police recovered the [stealing] jewels from the thief's house.
explanation: Passive अर्थ (चुराए गए) के लिए past participle आता है: 'stolen jewels'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

[Surprising by the sudden question], the candidate remained silent.

options.text: Having surprising by the sudden question

explanation: Candidate खुद surprised हुआ है, इसलिए past participle आता है: 'Surprised by the sudden question'।

question:
Improve the bracketed segment.

[Having completed] the report, she sent it to the manager.
explanation: Perfect participle 'Having completed' का doer 'she' है और report पहले पूरा हुआ, इसलिए कोई सुधार नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

Written in simple language, (A) / the book has become popular (B) / among the school students. (C)
explanation: Past participle phrase 'Written in simple language' का doer 'the book' ही है, इसलिए structure सही है। कोई error नहीं।

question:
Spot the error.

Having been warned about the danger, (A) / the trekkers decided (B) / to return to the base camp. (C)

options.text: Having been warned about the danger,
to return to the base camp.

explanation: 'Having been warned' का doer 'the trekkers' है, इसलिए sentence सही है। कोई error नहीं।
